shortDescription: Matthew Tuttle, chief executive officer of Tuttle Capital, said he is concerned about higher yields and expects another leg of the AI trade if rates remain steady, according to Bloomberg.He also discussed Tuttle Capital's ETF business on the sidelines of the KBFG Korea Conference in Seoul.

title: Tuttle Capital CEO Sees Higher Yields as a Concern
